reviews.title: Monitors the temp but no alarm
reviews.text:
Very disappointed. The sensor and software seem to work fine for temperature reading, BUT the alarm did not signal when the set temperature was reached. No alarm. No vibration. Kind of useless and not good value for the $50 spent. 
On a side note, the instruction manual is not good at all. No useful information. 
Overall, a bad choice for a meat thermometer.

reviews.title: Horrible settings
reviews.text: This app has no way seemingly to dismiss an alarm for a temperature. It goes off every 10-20seconds until you cancel the cook. Horrible design, not allowing you to snooze it or dismiss fully. Also it blocks the entire app when it triggers so I have gotten stuck several times trying to update a temp or making a note but having to close the app because the keyboard is blocking the dismiss button and I can close the keyboard because I have to address the pop up first.

reviews.title: Don’t bother
reviews.text: I downloaded the app and was super excited to try it out but not once could I get the device to pair with either my iPad or my iPhone. The start pairing button was too low on the screen of my phone and would activate Siri instead of trying to pair so then I downloaded on my iPad and while the button is larger, even with the extra real estate would not let me start the pairing process with the device. The device itself works fine, but it does not allow me to pair with the app, which was one of the key reasons for this purchase.
